import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class VisuallyHidden extends KrdsElement {
    static styles: import("lit").CSSResult[];
    static properties: {
        content: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
    };
    content: string;
    variant: string;
    constructor();
    private control;
    private showFocus;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
